response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software engineering (15+ years) with a strong focus on full-stack development, cloud technologies, and emerging areas like AI-agent infrastructure. However, his resume lacks explicit AI-related products, platforms, or entrepreneurial experience within larger organizations, which are key preferences for this role. His open-source GISCollective project shows leadership and innovation but does not directly align with AI strategy or cloud product development.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience with diverse tech stacks (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, Java, etc.)
Proven leadership in open-source projects (GISCollective) and community contributions (workshops, talks)
Strong full-stack development skills with experience in cloud-native and distributed systems
concerns: No clear evidence of AI-specific products, platforms, or strategy experience in resume
Lacks entrepreneurial or startup experience within larger organizations (preferred qualification)
CV does not highlight recognized expertise in AI or demonstrated products built with AI
